events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war has escalated, and the US has shown its military strength, but also its waning geopolitical power. The war has become a conflict of military, economy, and geopolitics. The Atlantic Council has outlined four scenarios for geopolitics after the Iran war.
events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war will likely lead to increased demand for defense equipment and services, benefiting the aerospace and defense sector. On the other hand, the war may lead to a decrease in oil production and prices, negatively impacting the oil services sector.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the situation and adjust the position accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Exit the position if the war de-escalates or if the US announces a withdrawal from the conflict

gains.conservativeNote: If the war continues at its current level
gains.extendedNote: If the war leads to a significant increase in defense spending

events.title: US Interest Rate Hike
events.summary: The Federal Reserve may need to hike interest rates this year to confront inflation, according to Logan. Two Fed officials have warned of interest rate hike potential, and the odds of a Fed hike this year have jumped on prediction markets.
events.reasoning: An interest rate hike would lead to a decrease in bond prices and an increase in bond yields, benefiting long-term Treasury bond holders. On the other hand, a rate hike may lead to a decrease in stock prices, negatively impacting the S&P 500.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the Fed's decision and adjust the position accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Exit the position if the Fed decides not to hike interest rates

gains.conservativeNote: If the Fed hikes interest rates by 25 basis points
gains.baseNote: If the Fed hikes interest rates by 50 basis points
gains.extendedNote: If the Fed hikes interest rates by 75 basis points or more

events.title: Nvidia AI Spending
events.summary: Nvidia has partnered with TSMC to bring AI into fabs to advance semiconductor design and manufacturing. The company has also signed a major AI deal with Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing.
events.reasoning: Nvidia's partnership with TSMC and its deal with Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing will likely lead to an increase in demand for its AI-related products and services, benefiting the company's stock price. On the other hand, the increased competition in the AI sector may negatively impact AMD's stock price.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the company's progress and adjust the position accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Exit the position if Nvidia's AI-related revenue growth slows down

gains.conservativeNote: If Nvidia's AI-related revenue grows by 20% YoY
gains.baseNote: If Nvidia's AI-related revenue grows by 30% YoY
gains.extendedNote: If Nvidia's AI-related revenue grows by 40% YoY or more

events.reasoning: A positive economic growth outlook will likely lead to an increase in stock prices, benefiting the S&P 500. On the other hand, a decrease in bond prices and an increase in bond yields may negatively impact long-term Treasury bond holders.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the economic growth and adjust the position accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Exit the position if the economic growth slows down
